population.sample_rule: population, no sampling; listed order = sha256(attempt_id)

length_control.note: descriptive only: the rule has no length feature

dt5b_cross_tab.note: DT-5b's unit is a wrapped run from SK-5 (167 runs: 143 positive/24 honest); DA-3b's unit is an attempt from five source runs. The join is run_id == '<regime>-<task_id>-s<sample>' with a length check, so only the SK-5 attempts overlap.
